_notice: Twenty-four estimates written and labelled against the engine frozen at commit 6a62ce8, after the fixes the first transfer set prompted and before this set was read. It shares no document, and few layouts, with any other corpus: product-code columns, amounts suffixed USD, quantity @ rate, lettered and parenthesised items, good/better/best tiers, an insurance supplement with overhead and profit, a member discount, a not-to-exceed allowance, exclusions stated in brackets. Labels follow the first set's conventions. No name, licence number or claim number refers to a real company or person.

documents.title: Kitchen circuits by email: one price, an exclusion in a sentence
documents.text:
Hi Priya - following up on today's visit. For the kitchen we'd run two new 20 amp small-appliance circuits from the panel, swap the six existing outlets on the counter for GFCI-protected ones, and add under-cabinet LED lighting on a new switch by the door. Patch and paint of any wall openings is not included. We'd do all of it for $2,350, permit included. Let me know and I'll get you on the schedule.
- Owen, Keystone Electric

documents.text: Hi this is Rick w/ Top Notch Roofing. Looked at your roof, you've got hail hits all over the south side and a couple lifted tabs. I'd replace the south slope only, about 12 squares, new felt, drip edge, match the shingle best I can. $5,200 for that. Insurance might cover it, happy to meet the adjuster.
